sentences.en: For the last three weeks, a messy, dramatic battle has played out between two of the most powerful titans of tech in the world, Elon Musk and Sam Altman.
sentences.zh: 过去三周，全球两位最具权势的科技巨头——埃隆·马斯克和萨姆·奥特曼之间，上演了一场混乱而戏剧性的博弈。

sentences.en: In a high-stakes lawsuit, Musk is seeking to cripple one of the leaders of the AI boot,
sentences.zh: 在一场高风险的诉讼中，马斯克试图重创人工智能领域的领军者之一，

sentences.en: OpenAI, and remove Altman as its chief executive.
sentences.zh: 即OpenAI，并罢免奥特曼的首席执行官职务。

sentences.en: Today, as jury deliberations in the trial begin, tech reporter Mike Isaac takes us inside the courtroom drama and explains how a corporate dispute got extremely personal.
sentences.zh: 今天，随着庭审进入陪审团审议阶段，科技记者迈克·艾萨克将带我们走进法庭内的戏剧性现场，并解释这场公司纠纷是如何演变成极度个人化的冲突的。

sentences.en: So, it's kind of like trying to get in the club, but the club is people worried about the end of the world because of AI, basically.

sentences.en: What about inside?

sentences.en: You know, we all have to go into this federal courthouse,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们都得进入这个联邦法院，

sentences.en: and it's a pretty intimate hallway that leads to the courtroom.

sentences.en: And then on the other side is like a holding pin where they keep all the like billionaires that don't want to be around people like me all day.
sentences.zh: 另一边是一个候审室，专门关那些不想整天和我们这种人待在一起的亿万富翁。

sentences.en: And they have to essentially walk past us to get into the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上必须从我们身边走过才能进入法庭。

sentences.en: So, every day on the way in, you have Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, one of the other co-founders of OpenAI, all the sort of like bigwigs of AI kind of coming
sentences.zh: 所以每天进门时，埃隆·马斯克、萨姆·奥特曼、OpenAI的另一位联合创始人格雷格·布罗克曼，以及所有AI界的大佬们，都会放下身段，

sentences.en: down to earth and dealing with the press and the public and their fans and their detractors.
sentences.zh: 应对媒体、公众、粉丝和批评者。

sentences.en: But it's more than that.
sentences.zh: 但不仅如此。

sentences.en: It's this moment where the stakes are pretty big here.
sentences.zh: 这一刻的赌注非常大。

sentences.en: Talk about that.
sentences.zh: 谈谈这个吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's Musk levying this lawsuit, which has been years now in the making.
sentences.zh: 马斯克发起的这场诉讼，筹备已经好几年了。

sentences.en: He's saying that with this project that he got involved with, with OpenAI so many years ago, he was duped, essentially, from creating what he thought would be a non-profit to build
sentences.zh: 他说，对于多年前参与的OpenAI项目，他基本上是被骗了，他以为自己是在创建一个非营利组织，旨在为人类利益构建

sentences.en: artificial intelligence for the good of mankind.
sentences.zh: 人工智能。

sentences.en: And instead, what Elon Musk says is that he was tricked by his co-founders, Sam Altman,
sentences.zh: 而埃隆·马斯克称，他被自己的联合创始人萨姆·奥特曼、

sentences.en: Greg Brockman, who decided they wanted to make it a for-profit company once they had stars and dollar signs in their eyes.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·布罗克曼欺骗了，他们一旦看到名利双收的机会，就决定将其变成一家营利性公司。

sentences.en: And I think it's, you know, there's a lot of lawsuits that fly around Silicon Valley, but this one could really damage OpenAI, what is now almost a trillion dollar private company.
sentences.zh: 我认为，硅谷虽然诉讼不断，但这一起可能会真正损害OpenAI，这家如今估值近万亿美元的私营公司。

sentences.en: Say why?
sentences.zh: 说说为什么？

sentences.en: So, Musk is asking for a lot.
sentences.zh: 马斯克要求的赔偿很多。

sentences.en: For one, he wants $150 billion, with a B, dollars in damages.
sentences.zh: 首先，他要求1500亿美元的赔偿金，注意是“亿”。

sentences.en: But he's saying, not for me, of course.
sentences.zh: 但他当然会说，这钱不是给我的。

sentences.en: It's to be returned to the non-profit organization, which is like the parent of OpenAI, the for-profit company.
sentences.zh: 这是要归还给非营利组织，也就是OpenAI这家营利性公司的母体。

sentences.en: So, it's like this, quote-unquote, selfless moment that he's trying to do.
sentences.zh: 所以，他试图营造一种所谓的“无私”时刻。

sentences.en: Musk is also asking for them to unwind this for-profit structure that they've devised and basically turn OpenAI back into exclusively a non-profit.
sentences.zh: 马斯克还要求他们拆解现有的营利性结构，基本上是将OpenAI恢复为纯粹的非营利组织。

sentences.en: And finally, we have, I guess what would be the coup de grace for management, which is to basically remove Sam Altman and Greg Brockman from the top of the company and the board
sentences.zh: 最后，我想这对于管理层来说是致命一击，那就是将萨姆·奥特曼和格雷格·布罗克曼从公司高层和董事会中移除。

sentences.en: of directors.
sentences.zh: 董事会。

sentences.en: Mike, I think it's going to be news to people that OpenAI even has a non-profit company attached to it.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我想很多人都不知道OpenAI名下竟然还有一个非营利组织。

sentences.en: So, I want you to kind of go back to the beginning, which seems like is at the heart of this case.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想请你回到最初，这似乎是本案的核心。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Rewind to 2015.
We have this moment of Elon Musk sitting down with Larry Page, chief executive of Google, and having basically a big disagreement over the future of what AI should look like.
sentences.zh: 当时埃隆·马斯克与谷歌首席执行官拉里·佩奇坐在一起，就AI未来的发展方向产生了巨大的分歧。

sentences.en: Musk says, I'm very worried.
sentences.zh: 马斯克说，我非常担心。

sentences.en: Apparently, he's been talking at parties forever how he's very concerned about the future of
sentences.zh: 显然，他一直在各种聚会上谈论自己对AI未来的担忧，

sentences.en: AI and it harming humanity.
sentences.zh: 担心它会伤害人类。

sentences.en: Larry Page says, whatever, it's fine.
sentences.zh: 拉里·佩奇说，无所谓，没关系。

sentences.en: You know, the way that AI will progress, even if it's not for the good of mankind, it's still going to be okay because AI will survive past us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，AI的发展方式，即使不是为了人类的利益，也没关系，因为AI会比我们活得更久。

sentences.en: Musk is shocked and aghast by that and saying, you know, you don't care about humanity.
sentences.zh: 马斯克对此感到震惊和愤怒，他说，你根本不在乎人类。

sentences.en: Page calls him a speciesist, which is a funny, new to me word.
sentences.zh: 佩奇称他为“物种歧视者”，这是一个很有趣的词，我还是第一次听说。

sentences.en: Not a term I've heard.
sentences.zh: 我没听过这个词。

sentences.en: 100% saying, you know, like he's being discriminatory against an artificial intelligence robot.
sentences.zh: 百分之百是说，他是在歧视人工智能机器人。

sentences.en: And Elon's like, I got to do something about Google, goes and starts talking with Sam Altman,
sentences.zh: 埃隆觉得，我必须对谷歌做点什么，于是他开始与萨姆·奥特曼交谈，

sentences.en: who then was running a startup incubator in Silicon Valley and saying, this is existential stuff.
sentences.zh: 当时奥特曼正在硅谷经营一家创业孵化器，马斯克说，这是关乎生存的大事。

sentences.en: We need to worry about what AI could do for the future.
sentences.zh: 我们需要担心AI未来可能带来的后果。

sentences.en: Thus, OpenAI was born.
sentences.zh: 于是，OpenAI诞生了。

sentences.en: And the idea was, we should be the ones building the future of artificial intelligence, but we need to do it safely and build it in an altruistic manner, let's say.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，我们应该成为构建人工智能未来的人，但我们需要安全地去做，并以利他的方式去构建，姑且这么说吧。

sentences.en: And Elon Musk was the money man, right?
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克是出资人，对吧？

sentences.en: He had made a ton of money on PayPal.
sentences.zh: 他在PayPal上赚了一大笔钱。

sentences.en: He was building Tesla and doing really well.
sentences.zh: 他当时正在打造特斯拉，做得非常成功。

sentences.en: He had SpaceX and, you know, this feels long ago, but his star was also pretty high.
sentences.zh: 他还有SpaceX，虽然感觉是很久以前的事了，但当时他的名气也非常高。

sentences.en: And there was, it was mostly seeing him as like Iron Man slash Boy Wonder inventions guy.
sentences.zh: 人们大多把他看作是“钢铁侠”式的发明家。

sentences.en: And, you know, the entrepreneur that everyone loved.
sentences.zh: 而且，他是大家都喜爱的创业者。

sentences.en: So he was the one that was like, OK, I'm going to fund this thing.
sentences.zh: 所以他当时说，好吧，我来资助这个项目。

sentences.en: That's a money losing endeavor.
sentences.zh: 那是一个亏钱的买卖。

sentences.en: But that's the point, because we're doing this for the good of mankind, basically.
sentences.zh: 但重点就在于此，因为我们基本上是为了人类的利益在做这件事。

sentences.en: And from the beginning, everyone involved, including Musk, Altman, they agree AI is this incredibly important technology and that it's really critical that they be in charge
sentences.zh: 从一开始，所有参与者，包括马斯克和奥特曼，都同意AI是一项极其重要的技术，而且由他们以利他主义的方式来掌控这项技术至关重要，

sentences.en: of it as an altruistic endeavor so that, in their minds, the good guys are the stewards of this ultra powerful thing that's coming.
sentences.zh: 这样在他们看来，好人才能成为这种即将到来的超强力量的守护者。

sentences.en: And the thought is, Altman is going to build it and Musk is going to fund it.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，奥特曼负责开发，马斯克负责出资。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, the funny thing going on in this trial, too, is just sort of seeing a window into how they were talking about it over email at the time.
sentences.zh: 而且，这场庭审中还有一件有趣的事，就是能看到他们当时通过邮件交流的窗口。

sentences.en: And like, this was when no one cared about AI and it was kind of a fringe pursuit.
sentences.zh: 那时根本没人关心AI，它还是一种边缘化的追求。

sentences.en: And they were all talking about it like the far flung universe in which AI was going to take over the world.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论AI时，就像在谈论一个AI将接管世界的遥远宇宙。

sentences.en: They were serious about it.
sentences.zh: 他们对此非常认真。

sentences.en: It's interesting because we hear so much of that now, these doomerous kind of concerns about AI, but you're saying privately amongst each other, they were voicing that early on.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为我们现在听到了太多关于AI的末日论担忧，但你说他们私下里很早就表达过这种担忧了。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, I've been out here in the Valley for like 16, 17 years and pretty cynical.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我在硅谷待了16、17年了，相当愤世嫉俗。

sentences.en: And usually when I hear these sort of grand proclamations about worrying about humanity,
sentences.zh: 通常当我听到这种关于担忧人类命运的宏大宣言时，

sentences.en: I'm just like, OK, all right.
sentences.zh: 我只会觉得，好吧，行吧。

sentences.en: But like they've been talking about this for a long time in the same way and weren't performing on an email chain of three people.
sentences.zh: 但他们在那三个人的邮件链里，长期以来一直以同样的方式讨论这个问题，并不是在演戏。

sentences.en: OK, so these guys joined forces.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以这些人联手了。

sentences.en: They're aligned on mission.
sentences.zh: 他们的使命是一致的。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Musk, who, by the way, is running multiple companies, is kind of a figure in the background who is paying the rent.
sentences.zh: 马斯克当时身兼数职，基本上是个幕后人物，负责付房租。

sentences.en: He's got the checks coming in, funding this thing, while Sam Altman and Greg Brockman are trying to do the work of building the next generation AI models, right?
sentences.zh: 他负责出钱资助这个项目，而萨姆·奥特曼和格雷格·布罗克曼则负责开发下一代AI模型，对吧？

sentences.en: We get to around 2017, 2018,
sentences.zh: 时间到了2017年、2018年左右，

sentences.en: Greg and Sam start talking about if we need to develop these models the way we want to, we are going to need a heck of a lot more money.
sentences.zh: 格雷格和萨姆开始讨论，如果我们想按我们想要的方式开发这些模型，我们需要更多的钱。

sentences.en: And maybe like in the millions, tens of millions, billions even, like long before the insane sums we know we're spending now.
sentences.zh: 可能需要数百万、数千万，甚至数十亿，远超我们现在所知的疯狂投入。

sentences.en: But they start saying this not-for-profit model, the way we have it structured may not work entirely.
sentences.zh: 但他们开始说，这种非营利模式，以我们目前的结构可能行不通。

sentences.en: They're basically realizing this is going to be super resource intensive and a nonprofit isn't going to get us where we need to be to build the thing we need to build.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上意识到，这将是资源密集型的，非营利模式无法让我们实现构建所需目标。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.

sentences.en: They're saying Elon Musk is just a spurned guy who feels like he's being out-competed and he's mad that he didn't have control over this thing.
sentences.zh: 而OpenAI律师对付马斯克的方式，我认为，是马斯克可能不常被对待的方式。

sentences.en: And the way that OpenAI's attorneys come at Musk is, I think, a way that Musk probably doesn't get spoken to that often.
sentences.zh: 他开始受到交叉盘问的刺激，问题暗示他不诚实、虚伪或自相矛盾。

sentences.en: He starts getting prodded by cross-examination and questions insinuating that he's being untruthful or hypocritical or contradictory.
sentences.zh: 之前那个谦逊、随和、创业者形象的马斯克开始消失了。

sentences.en: And the humble sort of aw shucks, entrepreneurial Musk from before starts melting away.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了拳击手马斯克，对吧？

sentences.en: And we get Musk, the pugilist, right?
sentences.zh: 他开始变得尖刻，说：“你太虚伪了。”

sentences.en: He starts getting snippy and saying, you're being disingenuous.
sentences.zh: “你不是在说实话。”

sentences.en: You're not telling the truth.
sentences.zh: “你问我的问题不是是非题。”

sentences.en: The questions you're asking me are not yes or no questions.
sentences.zh: 他开始纠结于别人对他说话的方式，

sentences.en: And getting really sort of caught up in the details of how he's being spoken to,
sentences.zh: 语气从鼓舞人心变成了他真的非常愤怒，对其他律师感到非常不满。

sentences.en: it went from like inspirational tone to him being really mad and really upset with the other attorneys.
sentences.zh: 这是那种可能走向任何一种结果的事情之一。

sentences.en: And it's one of those things that could go either way.
sentences.zh: 当他进行这些反击时，比如说，我周围有一些人显然是来看马斯克的。

sentences.en: When he was getting these little clapbacks in, let's say, there were guys around me who were clearly there to view Musk.
sentences.zh: 他们会握拳庆祝，或者对马斯克的笑话或尖刻言辞发笑。

sentences.en: And they would do little fist pumps or laugh at like Musk's jokes or snippiness.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the gallery was sort of popping off.
sentences.zh: 当时旁听席简直炸开了锅。

sentences.en: Were people really fist bumping in the audience?
sentences.zh: 观众席里真的有人在碰拳吗？

sentences.en: Oh my God, you have no idea.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你根本想象不到。

sentences.en: It was a wild gallery.
sentences.zh: 那场面真是疯狂。

sentences.en: When I was in the back, I would hear snickers around me from people who were clearly fans of Musk when they felt he was scoring a point against the lawyers.
sentences.zh: 我坐在后面时，能听到周围传来的窃笑声，那些人显然是马斯克的粉丝，每当他们觉得马斯克在律师面前占了上风时，就会笑出来。

sentences.en: It was like a show, man.
sentences.zh: 伙计，那就像一场表演。

sentences.en: It was like really like a cage match happening.
sentences.zh: 真的就像在打笼斗赛一样。

sentences.en: It was a trip.
sentences.zh: 那感觉太奇妙了。

sentences.en: That was the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键就在这儿。

sentences.en: It was sort of like people wanted the Elon show and they got it.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像大家想看“埃隆秀”，而他们确实看到了。

sentences.en: And it was one of these moments for the open AI lawyers to show, hey, look, this is how Elon Musk can get when he doesn't get his way.
sentences.zh: 这对OpenAI的律师来说是一个展示的机会，让他们向大家展示：嘿，看吧，这就是埃隆·马斯克在不如意时会有的样子。

sentences.en: Essentially, it was the idea that this is about Musk being mad that he's not in control.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这就是在说马斯克是因为失去了控制权而感到愤怒。

sentences.en: He's being left behind.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己被抛在了后面。

sentences.en: And now he's throwing a tantrum.
sentences.zh: 现在他正在闹脾气呢。

sentences.en: Okay, what about Sam Altman?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那萨姆·奥特曼呢？

sentences.en: What was the Altman show?
sentences.zh: “奥特曼秀”又是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Yeah, so how do I put this?
sentences.zh: 嗯，该怎么说呢？

sentences.en: I wouldn't call him like classically charismatic.
sentences.zh: 我不会说他具有那种典型的个人魅力。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But I think he has a type of charisma that actually works for him.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他有一种对他本人很管用的魅力。

sentences.en: He's more soft spoken.
sentences.zh: 他说话更温和。

sentences.en: He was leaning into this sort of like, I'm an entrepreneur who cares about the world.
sentences.zh: 他一直在营造一种“我是一个关心世界的创业者”的形象。

sentences.en: Clearly not as famous as Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 显然他没有埃隆·马斯克那么出名。

sentences.en: But I came from humble beginnings and I built startups.
sentences.zh: 但他会说自己出身卑微，是一步步建立起初创公司的。

sentences.en: I worked in Silicon Valley with other optimistic entrepreneurs and it worked for him.
sentences.zh: 他在硅谷和其他乐观的创业者一起工作，这套说辞对他很管用。

sentences.en: You know, like I think it was a chance for him to really present himself to the jury for the first time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得这是他第一次真正向陪审团展示自己的机会。

sentences.en: And I do think that he presented well in that regard.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他在那方面表现得不错。

sentences.en: You know, he tried to talk about his passion for tech and for building things and this idea of getting into the technology industry to make a positive difference in the world.
sentences.zh: 他试图谈论自己对科技和创造事物的热情，以及进入科技行业是为了给世界带来积极改变的初衷。

sentences.en: And how did Musk's lawyers try to poke holes in that image?
sentences.zh: 那马斯克的律师是如何试图拆穿这种形象的呢？

sentences.en: So, this is where things get super gnarly for Altman.
sentences.zh: 这就是事情对奥特曼来说变得非常棘手的地方。

sentences.en: There has been piece after piece of the image of Sam Altman being chipped away in public.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·奥特曼在公众心目中的形象已经被一点一点地瓦解了。

sentences.en: A lot of this started when he was briefly fired from his job from the board of directors and then reinstated,
sentences.zh: 这一切很大程度上始于他被董事会短暂解雇又被复职的时候，

sentences.en: which the reason he was fired was because he was, quote unquote, not consistently candid with the executives at the company.
sentences.zh: 他被解雇的原因是，引用他们的话说，他“对公司高管不够坦诚”。

sentences.en: There have been articles about him being duplicitous, telling people one thing and then telling people completely opposite things five minutes later.
sentences.zh: 有文章称他两面三刀，对人说一套，五分钟后又对别人说完全相反的话。

sentences.en: There's a particularly damning article in The New Yorker a few weeks ago, basically painting him as just a fundamentally untrustworthy person.
sentences.zh: 几周前《纽约客》有一篇特别有杀伤力的文章，基本上把他描绘成一个根本不值得信任的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, while he may not be as famous as Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然他可能不如埃隆·马斯克出名，

sentences.en: the information that has been made public about him and that has gotten a lot of attention recently has basically amounted to accusations that he's deceptive.
sentences.zh: 但最近公开的关于他的信息，以及引起广泛关注的内容，基本上都指控他是个骗子。

sentences.en: I mean, if this is any indication, literally the first question out of Elon Musk's counsel's mouth was, are you trustworthy?
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果这能说明什么的话，埃隆·马斯克的律师问出的第一个问题就是：你值得信任吗？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Going down the gauntlet.
sentences.zh: 这可是下马威啊。

sentences.en: Just like a bucket of cold water in his face right off of the bat.
sentences.zh: 就像一上来就往他脸上泼了一盆冷水。

sentences.en: And it was funny, actually, because I don't even know how I would answer that.
sentences.zh: 说实话这很有趣，因为我甚至不知道自己该怎么回答这个问题。

sentences.en: I would probably say, like, I think so, or something.
sentences.zh: 我可能会说，我想是吧，之类的。

sentences.en: But, like...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: You are trustworthy, Mike.
sentences.zh: 你是值得信任的，迈克。

sentences.en: Well, I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢你的认可。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And I think he said what I said.
sentences.zh: 我想他说的和我刚才说的一样。

sentences.en: Like, I think so.
sentences.zh: 就是，我想是吧。

sentences.en: Like, yeah, I would like to believe so.
sentences.zh: 就是，是的，我愿意相信是这样。

sentences.en: And then immediately, Elon's lawyers were like, oh, you think so?
sentences.zh: 然后埃隆的律师立刻就说：哦，你“想”是吧？

sentences.en: You're not immediately trustworthy?
sentences.zh: 你不是立刻就能让人信任的吗？

sentences.en: Are you not trustworthy?
sentences.zh: 难道你不值得信任吗？

sentences.en: Like, it was brutal.
sentences.zh: 那场面真是残酷。

sentences.en: And it was very much just a parade of, here are all the ways we think you're a bald-faced liar in every aspect of your life.
sentences.zh: 那简直就是一场游行，列举了所有他们认为你在生活各个方面都是个彻头彻尾的骗子的证据。

sentences.en: Just over and over and over again, you're saying?
sentences.zh: 你是说一遍又一遍地重复？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, I was uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我都觉得不舒服。

sentences.en: I'd do this for a living.
sentences.zh: 我可是靠这个为生的。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, God.
sentences.zh: 当时我都觉得，哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Oh, that's brutal.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太残忍了。

sentences.en: Please stop.
sentences.zh: 请停下吧。

sentences.en: I think it can be kind of a gamble.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这可能是一种赌博。

sentences.en: Like, maybe the jury absorbed it, or maybe they thought it was a bit much.
sentences.zh: 也许陪审团听进去了，或者他们觉得这有点过火了。

sentences.en: But the picture that Musk's counsel was trying to paint was essentially, this guy is not building AI for the right reasons.
sentences.zh: 但马斯克的律师试图描绘的画面本质上是：这家伙搞AI不是为了正确的目的。

sentences.en: Elon Musk is, and Sam Altman is not.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克是为了正义，而萨姆·奥特曼不是。

sentences.en: What's Altman's demeanor as these accusations are being presented to him?
sentences.zh: 当这些指控摆在他面前时，奥特曼的表现如何？

sentences.en: He tried to sort of be humble and say, I think I'm trustworthy.
sentences.zh: 他试图表现得谦逊，说“我想我是值得信任的”。

sentences.en: And then slowly, over the course of hours of questioning, started to push back and started being a little more forceful in his pushback.
sentences.zh: 然后经过几个小时的盘问，他开始反击，反击的力度也越来越强。

sentences.en: He certainly was not like Elon, who would just throw insults right back at the lawyers or whatever, you know.
sentences.zh: 他当然不像埃隆那样，会直接对律师进行人身攻击什么的，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I think Altman was, you know, probably had the foresight to not come off as snippy in that regard.
sentences.zh: 我想奥特曼大概有先见之明，知道在那方面不能显得尖酸刻薄。

sentences.en: But I think after, like, hour one of getting called, you know, Satan, he decided to start pushing back a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 但在被骂了一个小时的“撒旦”之后，他决定开始多反击一点了。

sentences.en: It's interesting how personal this all sounds.
sentences.zh: 这一切听起来如此个人化，真有意思。

sentences.en: Like, you said this trial feels very much about the characters of these two men.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的那样，这场审判感觉非常像是关于这两个人的性格之争。

sentences.en: It's ostensibly about whether this company that was a nonprofit betrayed its original mission.
sentences.zh: 表面上，这是关于这家非营利公司是否背叛了其最初的使命。

sentences.en: But at a really fundamental sense, it seems to be about who these people are at their core.
sentences.zh: 但从根本上讲，这似乎是关于这些人本质上是什么样的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: And I really think that's part of the point of why we've been getting into all these old emails and muckraking.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为这就是我们深挖这些旧邮件和揭露丑闻的原因之一。

sentences.en: It's because a lot of this trial feels kind of vibes-based at this point.
sentences.zh: 因为这场审判在这一点上感觉很大程度上是基于“氛围感”的。

sentences.en: You have to remember, this is a jury of nine people who are essentially trying to figure out kind of which side they trust more.
sentences.zh: 你得记住，这是一个由九个人组成的陪审团，他们本质上是在试图弄清楚他们更信任哪一方。

sentences.en: Is it Elon Musk telling the truth?
sentences.zh: 是埃隆·马斯克在说真话吗？

sentences.en: Is it Sam Altman?
sentences.zh: 还是萨姆·奥特曼？

sentences.en: And I think each new bit of evidence being introduced is trying to sway the jury a little bit more that actually this person shouldn't be trusted.
sentences.zh: 我认为每一条新证据的引入，都是为了让陪审团更倾向于认为这个人不值得信任。

sentences.en: Mike, you obviously can't say all that much about the jury.
sentences.zh: 迈克，你显然不能透露太多关于陪审团的事。

sentences.en: And it would be unfair for me to ask you to predict what's about to happen.
sentences.zh: 而且让你预测接下来会发生什么也是不公平的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: But I have to ask, who do you think came out on top in the war to prove to these nine people that they are the more credible one?
sentences.zh: 但我必须问，你认为在这场向这九个人证明自己更可信的战争中，谁赢了？

sentences.en: No, totally.
sentences.zh: 不，完全没问题。

sentences.en: Well, can I just tell you, as I was reporting this trial, I would get random messages from people who are trying to bet on the outcome of this trial on Kalshi and Polymarket.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我能告诉你的是，在我报道这场审判时，我会收到一些随机消息，有人试图在Kalshi和Polymarket上押注这场审判的结果。

sentences.en: Okay, that's not why I'm asking.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我问的不是这个。

sentences.en: I was going to say, so I'm not telling you if that's the case.
sentences.zh: 我正想说，所以我不会告诉你结果如何。

sentences.en: But no, also, I did not respond to any of them.
sentences.zh: 但没有，我也没有回复他们中的任何一个。

sentences.en: But it's too hard to tell, you know, and there's still a bunch of stuff that has to happen before we even get to a real outcome.
sentences.zh: 但很难说，你知道，在我们得到真正结果之前，还有很多事情要发生。

sentences.en: The jury has to deliberate on the verdict itself.
sentences.zh: 陪审团必须对裁决本身进行审议。

sentences.en: The judge has to decide what remedies are depending on who wins.
sentences.zh: 法官必须根据谁赢了来决定补救措施。

sentences.en: And I am sure there's going to be appeals after whatever decision comes.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信无论做出什么决定，之后肯定会有上诉。

sentences.en: So, Mike, setting aside who may win, what do you think the effect of this case will be,
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，撇开谁会赢不谈，你认为这个案子会有什么影响？

sentences.en: of all the mudslinging and the tarring and feathering of these two guys at this moment when public opinion of AI is so contested?
sentences.zh: 在公众对AI的看法如此充满争议的时刻，对这两个人进行的所有抹黑和羞辱会有什么影响？

sentences.en: I mean, it's not lost on me that this is all happening in a context where neither of these two men or AI in general is broadly beloved.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我并没有忽略这样一个事实：这一切发生在一个这两个人乃至AI本身都不太受大众欢迎的背景下。

sentences.en: Does it heighten the sense that people might have, the skepticism that people might have over the leaders of this hugely important industry?
sentences.zh: 这是否加剧了人们对这个极其重要的行业领导者的怀疑？

sentences.en: I mean, it certainly doesn't help to have all these gnarly emails from the past saying really bad stuff about each other out there for public consumption.
sentences.zh: 我是说，把过去这些关于对方的恶毒邮件公之于众，肯定没什么好处。

sentences.en: But I think you're exactly right.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: We're in this weird moment in Silicon Valley where everyone in AI realizes how much the average person isn't as enamored with it as they are, you know?
sentences.zh: 我们正处于硅谷一个奇怪的时刻，AI领域的每个人都意识到普通人对它的喜爱程度远不如他们，你知道吗？

sentences.en: You know, technologists see is this is how we can do things faster and better and these jobs are going to go away, but in service of something bigger and better.
sentences.zh: 你知道，技术人员看到的是：我们可以更快、更好地完成工作，虽然这些工作会消失，但这是为了更伟大、更好的目标。

sentences.en: And what the average person hears out in the rest of the world is you're going to take my jobs and you're going to, you know,
sentences.zh: 而普通人在外界听到的是：你们要抢走我的工作，你们要……你知道，

sentences.en: be richer than God and I'm going to be left with the scraps.
sentences.zh: 变得比上帝还富有，而我只能捡剩下的残羹冷炙。

sentences.en: Why would I, why would I see anything good in this, you know, whoever wins this case,
sentences.zh: 我为什么要觉得这有什么好呢？你知道，无论谁赢了这场官司，

sentences.en: there is something lost for both sides there because it's just a lot of real ugliness being dredged up for the public to see and, and judge for themselves, you know?
sentences.zh: 双方都有所损失，因为这只是把很多真正的丑陋面挖掘出来，让公众去观看和评判，不是吗？

sentences.en: So sure, they can say all day long that they want to get back to building and I'm sure that they do.
sentences.zh: 所以当然，他们可以整天说他们想回归建设，我相信他们确实想。

sentences.en: But also, this is part of the game, man.
sentences.zh: 但同时，这也是游戏的一部分，伙计。

sentences.en: This is how they chip away at each other in this incredibly intense competitive arena around racing to build AI.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们在AI竞赛这个极其激烈的竞争领域中互相拆台的方式。

sentences.en: Obviously, competition has always existed in this space,
sentences.zh: 显然，这个领域一直存在竞争，

sentences.en: but it just strikes me that what you're describing right now is so different from that era in 2015 that you heard about in this trial where there was a real sense of joint mission around this.
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得你现在描述的情况，与你在审判中听到的2015年那个时代截然不同，那时候大家有一种真正的共同使命感。

sentences.en: Look, Silicon Valley has always been a competitive place, but I was actually talking to my editor the other day and she was saying,
sentences.zh: 听着，硅谷一直是一个竞争激烈的地方，但我前几天和我编辑聊天时，她说，

sentences.en: I don't think I've ever seen it this crazy the entire time I've been reporting out here.
sentences.zh: 在我报道这里的整个过程中，我从来没见过这么疯狂的情况。

sentences.en: And I agree with her, you know, like there's something different about how people are competing in this AI race, you know?
sentences.zh: 我同意她的看法，你知道，人们在AI竞赛中的竞争方式确实有些不同，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's not just raising millions of dollars, it's tens of billions, hundreds of billions of dollars at stake.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是筹集数百万美元，而是数以百亿、千亿美元的赌注。

sentences.en: It's looking at your competitors and dragging their name and reputation through the mud any way you can.
sentences.zh: 这是盯着你的竞争对手，并尽一切可能把他们的名声和声誉拖入泥潭。

sentences.en: It's getting as much competitive intelligence on each other so you can throw it into a lawsuit or get some like nasty character assassination out there into the public.
sentences.zh: 这是尽可能多地获取对方的竞争情报，这样你就可以把它扔进诉讼中，或者在公众面前进行一些恶毒的人身攻击。

sentences.en: Like, it's doing whatever you can to keep other people from investing in your competitors.
sentences.zh: 就像是尽你所能阻止其他人投资你的竞争对手。

sentences.en: And you have Molotov cocktails being thrown at Sam Altman's house, for example.
sentences.zh: 比如，萨姆·奥特曼的房子都被人扔了燃烧瓶。

sentences.en: I mean, the public feeling about it is heightened too.
sentences.zh: 我是说，公众对此的感受也加剧了。

sentences.en: I think that's the other part of it, you know?
sentences.zh: 我认为这是另一部分原因，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Like, there's the money part and there are people who believe this is actually existential, you know?
sentences.zh: 就像，有金钱的部分，也有人认为这实际上关乎生存，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Actually, the stakes are not just, I'm going to have the next cool company.
sentences.zh: 实际上，赌注不仅仅是“我要拥有下一家酷公司”。

sentences.en: It's what happens to the human race if we fail.
sentences.zh: 而是如果我们失败了，人类会怎样。

sentences.en: But look, the jury's deliberating right now.
sentences.zh: 但听着，陪审团现在正在审议。

sentences.en: The trial is still, you know, a total up in the air thing.
sentences.zh: 审判仍然是一个完全悬而未决的事情。

sentences.en: But I think no matter what the outcome of this thing is, there's not really any coming back from how high stakes things are.
sentences.zh: 但我认为无论结果如何，事情已经发展到这种高风险的地步，就再也回不去了。

sentences.en: That's just how it is out here now.
sentences.zh: 这就是现在这里的情况。

sentences.en: Well, Mike, thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: On Monday, after deliberating for under two hours, the jury in the case ruled unanimously against Elon Musk's claims against OpenAI,
sentences.zh: 周一，在审议了不到两个小时后，该案陪审团一致裁定埃隆·马斯克对OpenAI的指控不成立，

sentences.en: meaning that OpenAI and Sam Altman weren't liable for any damages.
sentences.zh: 这意味着OpenAI和萨姆·奥特曼无需承担任何赔偿责任。

sentences.en: The jury found that Musk's lawsuit fell outside the three-year statute of limitations in the case.
sentences.zh: 陪审团发现马斯克的诉讼超出了该案三年的诉讼时效。

sentences.en: Musk filed the suit in 2024, and the jury found that he'd been aware of the company's structure as early as 2021.
sentences.zh: 马斯克于2024年提起诉讼，而陪审团发现他早在2021年就已经了解公司的结构。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Republican Senator Bill Cassidy decisively lost his primary over the weekend after President Trump targeted him for defeat.
sentences.zh: 共和党参议员比尔·卡西迪在周末的初选中惨败，此前特朗普总统曾针对他进行打击。

sentences.en: Trump was retaliating against Cassidy for voting to impeach him for inciting insurrection after he lost the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是在报复卡西迪，因为他在2020年大选失败后，投票弹劾特朗普煽动叛乱。

sentences.en: But you don't pout, you don't whine, you don't claim that election was stolen, you don't find a reason why.
sentences.zh: 但你不能嘟囔，不能抱怨，不能声称选举被窃取，你不能找任何借口。

sentences.en: In his concession speech, Cassidy took a thinly veiled swipe at Trump, saying America's leaders shouldn't be focused on one individual who demanded absolute loyalty.
sentences.zh: 在败选演讲中，卡西迪含蓄地抨击了特朗普，称美国的领导人不应该只关注一个要求绝对忠诚的个人。

sentences.en: But his defeat demonstrated the strength of Trump's hold on the party.
sentences.zh: 但他的失败证明了特朗普对该党控制力的强大。

sentences.en: Trump's chosen candidate, Julia Letlow, finished well ahead.
sentences.zh: 特朗普钦点的候选人朱莉娅·莱特洛遥遥领先。

sentences.en: A former Trump official finished second.
sentences.zh: 一位前特朗普政府官员获得了第二名。

sentences.en: And Cassidy couldn't even secure enough support to stay in the race.
sentences.zh: 而卡西迪甚至没能获得足够的支持留在竞选中。

sentences.en: Trump celebrated the result in a social media post, saying that Cassidy's, quote, disloyalty to the man who got him elected is now a part of legend.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在社交媒体上庆祝了这一结果，称卡西迪“对让他当选的人的不忠，现在已成为传奇”。

sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物不耐受吗？
